description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaKeySession class, specifically testing the isPlayreadyKeySystem() method for different key systems (Playready, Netflix, Widevine). It defines a test fixture class and three test cases to verify the behavior of the method with various key system inputs.

classes.name: RialtoServerMediaKeySessionIsPlayreadyKeySystemTest
classes.description: Test fixture class inheriting from MediaKeySessionTestBase, used to test isPlayreadyKeySystem() method with different key systems.

methods.name: ~RialtoServerMediaKeySessionIsPlayreadyKeySystemTest
methods.description: Destructor that calls destroyKeySession() to clean up after tests.

methods.name: ReturnTrueForMsPlayready
methods.description: Test case verifying that isPlayreadyKeySystem() returns true for the Microsoft Playready key system.

methods.name: ReturnTrueForNetflix
methods.description: Test case verifying that isPlayreadyKeySystem() returns true for the Netflix key system.

methods.name: ReturnFalseForWidevine
methods.description: Test case verifying that isPlayreadyKeySystem() returns false for the Widevine key system.
